How to transfer images to wood

The transfer works better if you have glossy laser printer paper or use some other clay coated paper like the pages of a magazine. The toner will loosely stick to the glossy paper so more transfer can occur. If you use magazine page cut to size for your printer, don't worry about the original page printing transferring as it is an ink and will not transfer like toner does. Of course this goes for inkjet printing as well so you can only do this with a laser printer or toner based copier printed material. I have had great success using a T-shirt heat press to transfer toner printouts to wood since it has high heat and you can dial up strong and uniform pressure on the workpiece.

This transfer method is great for wood burning (pyrography) since you can lightly transfer your design to the wood before your burn it with your wood burning tool. You can also use it to add some color to you wood burning by transferring a color laser printed design over your work if you line it up correctly.
